questions: Should the flattening handle arbitrarily deep nesting (e.g., [[['Pizza']]]) or only exactly two levels as implied by the examples?
If there are duplicate items within a single sublist, should they be counted separately (i.e., treat each occurrence) or deduplicated per sublist before counting?
Should the x-axis tick labels be placed at bar centers (default) or edges, and should the xticks be set explicitly to match the sorted labels?
What should happen if the input list is empty (i.e., []) or contains only empty sublists?
Are menu items case-sensitive? Should 'pizza' and 'Pizza' be considered distinct?
Should the function close or show the plot, or just return the Axes object without displaying?
If width is set >1.0, should bars overlap or be spaced apart? Does width refer to bar width in data units or fraction of spacing?
Should the histogram have any edgecolor or other stylistic defaults not mentioned (like gridlines, tick rotation)?
